evidence.why: No edge consumption.
Refresh exception and four invocations.

reason: Checker does not consume pressed mask; one toggle per fresh edge depends on caller refreshing slot. Multiple slots can toggle in one frame.

evidence.why: Input/output flow and ordering.
WAITDONE-first search.

reason: Correct ordering: sequence increments before formatting/write, using old value. LastDrawDone name does not guarantee exclusively completed status.

evidence.why: All local state transitions.
Reset uses configured speed, not saved previous speed or fixed 1.0.

reason: Unbounded monotonicity and speed-only-on-chord claims are too strong; reset and exported toggle exist, setup only clears latch, and reset speed is configured match speed.
